title: drydocs.review-quality.v1 — reviewer-quality limits (O51, intake plan §8)
description: Thresholds that FLAG an SME on the admin queue's quality rail. Nothing here acts: the admin decides whether to block, and the absence of any auto-block key is deliberate rather than an omission. Every rate limit is a fraction in [0,1] because every metric it is compared against is a share of the reviewer's decisions in the window.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

window_days.description: The rolling window every rate is computed over.

min_decisions_for_flag.description: Below this many decisions in the window, rates are REPORTED but nothing is flagged -- one return out of two submissions is a 50% rate and means nothing.

auto_accept_rate_max.description: Declared and UNUSED until O48 builds the candidate-binding set there is nothing to compare a confirmation against today.
